faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Assistant - Linguistics post at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Assistant - Linguistics position at IIT Kharagpur is 25-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant - Linguistics role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MA in Linguistics with at least 2 years of experience in linguistic fieldwork involving any minor or endangered language of India.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant - Linguistics position is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37000 per month.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant - Linguistics post at IIT Kharagpur.
